quote: Universality and Complexity in Cellular Automata (1984) - Wolfram posed the foundational question about which cellular automata could be computationally universal
note: The broader question about Turing completeness of cellular automata was posed in Wolfram's 1984 paper 'Universality and Complexity in Cellular Automata' (Physica D 10, no. 1-2: 1-35). He then made the specific conjecture about Rule 110 in 1985 and published 'Twenty Problems in the Theory of Cellular Automata' in Physica Scripta T9 (1985): 170-183, which explicitly posed the open problem of determining the Turing completeness status of all elementary cellular automata.
